name: hud_ui_numeric_text_input_set_input_active
description: HudUiNumericTextInput::SetInputActive toggles input active state and visibility on the input, slider border, and first label panel.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4b4ba0 yet; the helper currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x4b4ba0 validates returning the previous inputActive value, storing the new state, and dispatching SetVisible on self, slider border, and the first label panel when present.
The native smoke verifies deactivation and activation return previous states and toggle visible flags on all three elements.
